import Mathlib.Tactic
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.DomainAtlas
open Set Function Manifold
open scoped Manifold ContDiff Topology
variable {E H N : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [TopologicalSpace H] [TopologicalSpace N]
  {I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H} {K : Set N}

/-- Construct the intrinsic chart from a genuine ambient local model.
The set K retains its original subspace topology. -/
theorem exists_modelDomainChart (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H) (K : Set N)
    (e : OpenPartialHomeomorph N E) (he : e.IsImage K (range I))
    (p : K) (hp : p.1 ∈ e.source) :
    ∃ c : ModelDomainChart I K, c.ambient = e :=
/- SWARM_PROOF_BEGIN -/
by
  sorry
/- SWARM_PROOF_END -/
end PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.DomainAtlas
hint: Construct actual maps (not a new topology). Source in K is preimage of e.source and target in H is preimage of e.target under I. On the source use I.symm ∘ e ∘ Subtype.val; outside the source use I.symm(e p.1). For the inverse use e.symm ∘ I on the target, and p outside. IsImage proves membership of inverse in K. Partial inverses use e and I identities; continuityOn follows locally from the exact formulas on open source/target. Alternatively build the homeomorphism between open subspaces first and extend with existing APIs. The source-set, target-set and two formula fields are all required. Do not assume the desired intrinsic chart exists. This constructor is the actual existence bottleneck; helpers inside the proof are encouraged.

    (hx : f (x, neckCenter) ∈ frontier (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p)) (y : X) :
    f (y, neckCenter) ∈ frontier (closure (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p)) :=
/- SWARM_PROOF_BEGIN -/
by
  sorry
/- SWARM_PROOF_END -/
end PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.DomainAtlas
hint: The center is in closure D by the checked saturation result. Approach it by negative-parameter points; the checked oneSidedCollar_negative_not_mem_closure puts those outside closure D. Show 0 lies in closure of the negative interval in NeckParameter (the existing positive-side proof is a template, or reflect the parameter), and map this closure by continuous t ↦ f(y,t). Combine closure D with closure of its complement. This proves an actual regular-domain fact without assuming a smooth closure.

import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.DomainAtlas.Core
import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.DomainAtlas.CollarClosureFrontier
import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.Sphere
import Mathlib.Tactic
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.DomainAtlas
open Set Function Manifold
open scoped Manifold ContDiff Topology
variable {E H N : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [TopologicalSpace H] [TopologicalSpace N]
  {I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H} {K : Set N}

/-- Covering the frontier by genuine one-sided sphere collars derives regular openness. -/
theorem complementary_regularOpen_of_sphereCollars
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] [LocallyConnectedSpace Y]
    {C : Set Y} (hC : IsClosed C) {p : Y} (hp : p ∉ C)
    (hcover : ∀ y ∈ frontier (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p),
      ∃ f : Sphere2 × NeckParameter → Y,
        Topology.IsOpenEmbedding f ∧
        (∀ z, f z ∈ C ↔ (z.2 : ℝ) ≤ 0) ∧
        ∃ x : Sphere2, f (x, neckCenter) = y) :
    connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p = interior (closure (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p)) ∧
    frontier (closure (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p)) =
      frontier (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p) :=
/- SWARM_PROOF_BEGIN -/
by
  sorry
/- SWARM_PROOF_END -/
end PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.DomainAtlas
hint: The complement of closed C is open, so each connected component is open under local connectedness. The easy frontier-of-closure inclusion is general. For the reverse, choose the collar at a frontier point, turn its given equality into the contact condition, and apply the integrated center-frontier-closure lemma. Feed the resulting equality into existing regularOpen_of_frontier_closure_eq. Do not assume global connectedness or that exactly two spheres occur.

import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.DomainAtlas.Core
import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.DomainAtlas.Restriction
import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.DomainAtlas.ManifoldFamily
import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.DomainAtlas.InclusionEmbedding
import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.DomainAtlas.AmbientBridge
import Mathlib.Tactic
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.DomainAtlas
open Set Function Manifold
open scoped Manifold ContDiff Topology
variable {E H N : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [TopologicalSpace H] [TopologicalSpace N]
  {I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H} {K : Set N}

/-- From ambient smooth local set models, construct the full smooth closed-domain
structure and identify its intrinsic boundary with its actual ambient frontier. -/
theorem exists_smoothClosedDomain_structure [ChartedSpace E N]
    [IsManifold (𝓘(ℝ, E)) ∞ N] (hK : IsClosed K)
    (hlocal : ∀ p : K, ∃ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph N E,
      p.1 ∈ e.source ∧
      e ∈ IsManifold.maximalAtlas (𝓘(ℝ, E)) ∞ N ∧
      e.IsImage K (range I)) :
    ∃ cs : ChartedSpace H K,
      letI : ChartedSpace H K := cs
      IsManifold I ∞ K ∧
      IsSmoothEmbedding I (𝓘(ℝ, E)) ∞ (Subtype.val : K → N) ∧
      HasAmbientModelCharts I K ∧
      (Subtype.val : K → N) '' I.boundary K = frontier K :=
/- SWARM_PROOF_BEGIN -/
by
  sorry
/- SWARM_PROOF_END -/
end PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.DomainAtlas
hint: Choose each ambient chart from hlocal. For each p, the integrated existence theorem gives a ModelDomainChart whose ambient chart is the chosen one. Obtain covering from its source_eq and hlocal membership. Apply the integrated manifold-family and inclusion-embedding results and the ambient-model bridge. Then existing intrinsicBoundary_image_eq with hK identifies the actual boundary. Empty K must work without adding Nonempty K globally. This theorem constructs charted and smooth structure from real ambient local model data, not from a supplied IsManifold on K. Do not claim it already produces those ambient models for every surgery region.
